title: A Quiet Day in a Horse's World
caption:
A Quiet Day in a Horse's World | WildVox original narration and edit. Real horses across Iceland, meadows and woodland: how their daily routines change by place and season. Separate original recordings. #WildVox #Horses #Nature #AnimalBehavior

narration_timeline.text: A group of Icelandic horses stands close together, each looking in a different direction.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic group of Icelandic horses in one recording

narration_timeline.text: Elsewhere, a horse lowers its head to graze in an open patch of grass.
narration_timeline.scene: A genuine close horse grazing in California

narration_timeline.text: Two separate spring scenes show one pale horse drinking near water and another grazing beside the shore.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate recordings: a pale horse drinking at the shoreline and a single tan horse grazing beside the water; no group movement claimed.

narration_timeline.text: Another group of horses shifts position on the open ground along the water.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual additional Camargue horses on lakeside ground

narration_timeline.text: Later recordings show horses moving slowly through grass and stopping to feed.
narration_timeline.scene: Two separate authentic Camargue horses in the spring meadow

narration_timeline.text: Finally, a white horse grazes between trees. These different places reveal the quiet routines of horses.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual single white horse feeding among trees near woodland; no invented group by a lake.
